data.name: Jaydeep
data.gender_notes: Jaydeep is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit, Jaydeep means 'victorious deep'. This name holds significant importance in Hindu mythology, where Jay is a common prefix for various deities, and deep represents a deep sense of understanding, courage, and determination. The name Jaydeep carries the meaning “Victorious, Deep” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaydeep usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, deep and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jaydeep belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Deep.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaydeep total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
